6 تناسبوا (tropical:) They were mutually, or reciprocally, related; resembled one another; were similar, conformable, analogous, correspondent, or suitable, one to another; befitted one another. (TA.) See also نِسْبَةٌ. ―
-b2- [And تناسب It was suitable in its parts, proportionate, symmetrical, or uniform.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
